g.text: Methodology: §3.2 — What we measured; §7.9 — De-duplication rule 3

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Computed from 28,185 real requests. The combined figure of 9.68% and the code service at 1.34% both fall below even the pipeline's

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: low case; the conversation service at 15.46% is the one value inside the band, and only just. The 2023 release covers a single

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: 58-minute window on 16 November 2023, so it is a snapshot rather than a representative period, and it predates reasoning models and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: agentic tool-calling, both of which push output share up.
